title: Steam vertical capsule (748x896) from the one lithograph key design: the title rides the paper beam
use: Seasonal sales and some front-page blocks. One of the steam.* family: render every size from the same copy and palette; each size is re-composed, not cropped. Steam's graphical-asset rules allow only art, the game name and an official subtitle on capsules.

title_at.note: title centre along the beam, as a fraction of its length from the lantern (keeps the whole title in the paper light)

title_scale.note: title size against the measured size for this asset

misregister.note: ink plate offset over the rust under-plate, px at this size

dots_at.note: where the halftone starts eating the beam (fraction of its length)

rays.note: secondary rays in the light orange

title_latin.note: code-drawn wide stencil lettering (A-Z, 0-9, space and simple punctuation)

monument.note: your own monument or key object (PNG/SVG with alpha), placed at the lantern; the drawn lighthouse is used until it is filled

relations: The title sits inside the paper beam, on its axis, tilted with it (-12 to +8 degrees): it is the thing the light finds.
The monument is seen from below, bleeds off the bottom edge and is printed out of register over a rust plate.
Vermilion field dominates; the light is unprinted paper; the beam's far end dissolves into halftone; no gradients.
Every size is its own composition from the same parts: never crop one asset into another.
decoration: Halftone glow around the lantern, secondary rays, sea dashes, boats, beam slits through the title.

provenance.corpus: steam-capsules case round 2 (远灯 FARLAMP): our own original fictional indie game, one key design re-composed for 13 Steam assets
provenance.experiment: styles/cassandre-litho/style.json provenance; case renders in docs/cases/steam-capsules
provenance.method: Composition row for 748x896 from the case's final2.cjs (tower foot and lantern, beam angle, spread and length, title distance, size and tilt), scaled to the canvas; halftone and glow drawn as dot patterns instead of the case's PNG screens. Sizes checked against the Steamworks graphical-asset documentation (accessed 2026-11-05).
measured: Round 2 final: 0 findings; title ink on paper light 14.42:1.
OCR reads the tilted, slit title poorly at large sizes (2 of 11 sizes): a real cost of the bold title, judged by eye instead.
